{{Article header|section=Ships & Equipment|context=Ships|deck=Player-operated ground vehicles used by Commanders on planetary surfaces.}}

A '''Surface Recon Vehicle''' ('''SRV''') is a player-operated ground vehicle used by Commanders for activities on planetary surfaces. SRVs are transported aboard compatible ships using vehicle hangars and can be deployed after landing on suitable terrain.<ref name="frontier-equipment">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/equipment Equipment], Frontier Developments.</ref>

== Overview ==

Surface Recon Vehicles extend a Commander's capabilities beyond their ship, providing ground transportation and specialized equipment for planetary activities. Frontier describes SRVs as lightweight, all-terrain wheeled vehicles designed for exploring planetary surfaces, while also noting their usefulness for combat and surface charting.<ref name="frontier-equipment" />

Different SRVs emphasize different roles. The [[Scarab]] is the established general-purpose SRV for surface traversal and exploration, the [[Scorpion]] is oriented toward surface combat, and the [[Rhino]] has been announced as a larger SRV focused on [[Surface Mining|surface mining]].<ref name="frontier-rhino-dev-log">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-august-dev-log-2026 Elite Dangerous: August Dev Log 2026], Frontier Developments, 27 August 2026.</ref>

SRVs can support activities such as planetary traversal, exploration, raw material collection, settlement interaction, combat, and specialized resource extraction. Not every SRV is intended equally for every role.

== Scarab ==

The [[Scarab]] is a general-purpose Surface Recon Vehicle intended for planetary traversal, exploration, material collection, and other surface activities. It represents the standard SRV role described by Frontier's equipment overview: a lightweight, all-terrain wheeled vehicle for exploring and charting planetary surfaces.<ref name="frontier-equipment" />

== Scorpion ==

The [[Scorpion]] is a combat-oriented Surface Recon Vehicle designed for situations where surface combat is more important than the Scarab's general-purpose exploration role. It is used as an SRV for ground operations and is carried in a [[Planetary Vehicle Hangar]].

== Rhino ==

The [[Rhino]] is a large [[Vodel]] Surface Recon Vehicle designed primarily for [[Surface Mining|surface mining]]. It supports up to three Commanders and uses the [[Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar]]. Frontier has scheduled the Rhino for release on 2 September 2026.<ref name="frontier-rhino-dev-log" />

== Vehicle hangars ==

Surface Recon Vehicles are transported aboard ships using vehicle hangar modules. The Scarab and Scorpion use the [[Planetary Vehicle Hangar]]. The Rhino uses the larger [[Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar]].
